children: New Delhi, Nov. 7 -- Upcoming dividend, bonus, rights, record date next week: Shares of Dabur India, RITES, Container Corporation of India Limited, Hindustan Unilever Limited, ONGC, Taparia Tools, Emami, etc will remain in focus next week due to their upcoming dividend, bonus, rights issue record dates.

At least 75 companies have fixed record date for the coming week, ie between November 9 and November 13, 2026. Here are all the details about the record dates for upcoming dividend, bonus, rights issue, and other corporate actions.

Dabur India, Container Corporation of India, Emami, Jyothi Labs, Dr Lal Pathlabs, NBCC (India), RITES, Premier Energies, Godfrey Phillips India, Taparia Tools, Safari Industries India, Mobavenue AI Tech, Transworld Shipping Lines, Rain Industries, etc are among the key companies with dividend record dates.

Dharti Proteins is the only company out of 75 firms, which has fixed record date next week for bonus issue. The company's board of directors has approved bonus issue in the ratio of 1:1 with 13 November as record date.
Invetors who are willing to become eligible for any of the corporate action, must own the stock before record date to qualify for it.
